title: Medical English 19-20
category: Medical & Dental Questions > Medical English Question

questions.question: Which one is the correct word to fill up the gap in this sentence: Safrina has lost her cellphone again. This is the second time this -.
questions.explanation: কোনো কিছু বার বার ঘটে এরকম sense প্রকাশে present perfect tense ব্যবহৃত হয়। বাক্যটির বাংলা অর্থ: সামিয়া আবারও তার ফোন হারাল। ঘটনাটি দ্বিতীয়বারের মতো ঘটেছে।

questions.question: Which one of the following is past participle form of 'swim'?
questions.explanation: Swim (সাঁতার কাটা) এর past participle হবে swum

questions.question: I am accustomed __________ such a life.
questions.explanation: Be accustomed to sth (কোনোকিছুতে অভ্যস্থ হওয়া।) To যোগে বাক্যটির বাংলা অর্থ: আমি এরকম জীবনের সাথে অভ্যস্ত

questions.question: Alamin ______ Dhaka for ten years. Now he lives in Rangpur.
questions.explanation: যেহেতু এখন সে রংপুরে বাস করে তাই ঢাকায় বাস করার ঘটনাটি এখন অতীত। সুতরাং বাক্যটি simple past tense এ হবে।

questions.question: Which one of the following is an example of present perfect continuous tense?
questions.explanation: Present perfect continuous tense এর গঠন: subject + has/have been + v + ing + extension

questions.question: Which one of the following sentence is correct?
options: If I won the lottery, I bought a big house.
If I win the lottery, I shall buy a big house
If I won the lottery, I will buy a big house
If I won the lottery, I shall buy a big house.
questions.explanation: First conditional এর if যুক্ত clause টি present indefinite tense হলে, অন্য clause এর structure হবে: subject + shall/will/can/may + v₁ + extension

questions.question: For present perfect tense, which one of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: Present perfect tense এর structure: Sub. + have/has + V3 + extension.

questions.question: Synonym for 'Ability' are all of the following except:
questions.explanation: Avail সদ্ব্যবহার করা, কাজে লাগানো। এটা ability এর সমার্থক নয়। Ability শব্দের আরও কিছু সমার্থক শব্দ: capability, capacity, power, faculty, talent, skill, expertise ইত্যাদি।

questions.question: Which one of the following is not a noun?
For present continuous tense, which of the following is correct?
options: Don't make so much noise, I am trying to work
Don't make so much noise, I had tried to work.
Don't make so much noise, I tried to work
Don't make so much noise, I was trying to work.
questions.explanation: Present continuous tense এর structure: subject + am/is/are + (v+ing) + extension। কোনো কাজ বর্তমান চলছে এরকম বোঝালে present continuous tense হয়।

questions.question: Which one of the following sentences is in passive form?
options: Somebody is using the computer now.
They are building a new road in the city.
questions.explanation: বাক্যের passive structure সাধারণত be verb + V3 + by + extension হয়। সেই অনুযায়ী option A এবং D হয় না কারণ দুটি sentence -ই active form এ আছে। Option C তে present perfect tense আছে অর্থাৎ এটি passive নয়। সুতরাং option B সঠিক। বাক্যটির বাংলা অর্থ কক্ষটি পরিষ্কার করা হয়েছে অর্থাৎ কেউ (someone) এটাকে পরিষ্কার করেছে বা কারও দ্বারা (by someone) কক্ষটিকে পরিষ্কার করা হয়েছে।

questions.question: Antonym of 'Refractory' is:
questions.explanation: Refractory (অবাধ্য) এর বিপরীত শব্দ obedient (বাধ্য)। Stubborn শব্দের অর্থ জেদি, intractable শব্দের অর্থ সহজে নিয়ন্ত্রণ বা বশ করা যায় না এমন/অবাধ্য; cussed শব্দের অর্থ বেয়াড়া।

questions.question: She said, "I taught in many schools"-what is the indirect speech of the sentence?
options: She said she had educated in many schools
She said that she taught in many schools
She said she had taught in many schools.
She said that she had taught in many schools.
questions.explanation: Reporting verb past হওয়ায় reported spech এর past indefinite tense পরিবর্তিত হয়ে past perfect হবে।

questions.question: The word 'right' has been used as a verb in which of the following sentences?
options: It is a matter of right.
He is the right man for the job
It is such a fault that it will right itself
questions.explanation: Option A-তে right হলো noun, option B-তে right adverb এবং option C-তে right adjective. Option D তে right শব্দটি verb হিসেবে (সংশোধন করা অর্থে) বসেছে।

questions.question: In which of the following sentences 'but' is used as preposition?
options: We tried hard but did not succeed.
None but the brave deserves the fair
There is no one but likes him.
It is but right to admit our faults
questions.explanation: but এখানে without এর অর্থ দিচ্ছে। তাই এটা preposition|
